Page 235 Cont.
Sept. 20 Albert Hutt - 53 - Episcopelian - wife lutheran - ulcers of sto- mach ... bad shape is enrolled To-day.
22 Merelise Sutekeier from Muskegan - 6 - lost speech when 3 through or after hooping-cough. All she can say now is Mama and squeels ... stopted squeeling when we laughed and invited her jokingly to squeel again. Enrolled
Sarina Cosentino - 23 - rhumatic fever .... Enrolled Today.
Page 236 Sep. 22 Metty 25 and Elle Krieg -19 - figuering on marriage in October. Her parents hotly oppose because he is Catholic .... They ask for prayers ..
Hanna George - 52 - ... very sick - Husband & son ask prayers.
25 Joseph Walschon - 28 - T.B. of sholder-blade; supposed to be cured after carying cast on sholder for two years ..... Asked to what he attributed his cure to - he answered: "I came about two years ago and was urged to receive Holy Communion more frequently. After six months of daily Communion, finding myself decidedly improved and im- proving shortly after this venture for six months, I decided to con- tinue my daily Communions. Sick for about five years and unable to bless myself, except with my left hand ... I now feel that I am cured and can go back to work." In fact, he was sent for to take physical examination yesterday. However, having caught cold last Friday, he had temperature of 100 ... and was advised to get rid of cold and re- turn for exam. in two weeks ... for Board of Education.
Carolina Hoffman - 16 - unconscious since 10:30 a week last evening, when as Drs. believe a blood vessel broke in her head. Now in High- land Pk. Hospital - Enrolled To-day in Ser. Mass Assoc'n - Father promising to go more frequently to Com .....
V. Mother M. Patricia - prayers for funds to con. - Gr. Rapids. Good Sheph ...
Page 237 Sep. 23
Minnie (Mrs.) Stratman - 55 - diabetis - Varicose ulcers .... quite painful.
Miriam Berry - 13 - broke arm two months ago - July 16. Now Dr. finds it will probably be necessary to break it again - possibly worse.
